title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-08-03 10:03:48 最新章节：第3693章 我要是不退呢怎么和说的不一样
slug: 开局废了我开启最强进化
content_zh:
“同学们，老师再次郑重的提醒你们一次，距离各御灵使学院招生考核的日子，只有仅仅不到一个星期了。
老师希望你们能够好好的抓紧这几天时间，做好充足的准备，争取在一星期之后的考核，拿到好的成绩，考上你们理想中的学院。”
在一间教室之中，一个戴着眼镜的班主任，一脸严肃的说道。
当然，只有他知道，这不过是鼓励的话而已。
真正能够通过考核的人，实在是太少了。
就他自己这个班上，能有几个就不错了。
而坐在下面的学生，有的神情哀怨，有的十分高兴，各种各样的都有。
“好了，话我也就说到这里了，现在......放学。”
随后，班主任直接宣布了放学，转身离开了教室。
就在班主任离开房间之后，教室之内的各种声音此起彼伏。
“卧槽！
时间怎么过得这么快啊！
三年时间就这么一下就过了。”
“谁说不是呢？就凭我们现在的实力，四大顶级御灵使学院，想都不用想，高级御灵使学院，也基本上就不用考虑了，还是想一想，怎么才能考上一所御灵使学院吧，我要求不多，随便一所都行。”
“要是连一所普通的御灵使学院都进不去，那就真的完蛋了，只能当一辈子普通人。”
“哈哈哈哈！
我的目标可是高级御灵使学院，虽然够不到顶级的四大御灵使学院，以我的实力上个高级御灵使学院，完全没有问题。”
“羡慕啊！”
……
听到这个消息，有人欢喜有人愁。

欢喜的人自然是自我感觉实力已经足够的人，发愁的人就是自认为实力不济，随时都有可能被淘汰的人。
而在这一群人之中，有一个人一直坐在座位上。
和周围的吵闹完全不同，这人沉默不语，和周围的一切格格不入。
叶凌看着周围吵闹的同学，他的心情也非常的复杂。
只不过身为一个穿越者，看开了很多事情，整个人也成熟了很多。
不会因为这点事情，就大呼小叫，大吵大闹的。
但是一想到一个星期之后就要进行的公开招生考核，叶凌也忍不住望洋兴叹。
“唉！”
叶凌，本身并不是这个世界的人，而是一名穿越者。
在意外情况之下，于一星期前，来到这个世界。
魂魄直接鸠占鹊巢，将原本身体里面这个奄奄一息的魂魄吞噬殆尽。
content_en:
"Students, the teacher solemnly reminds you once again that there is only less than a week left before the enrollment and assessment days of each Imperial Spirit Envoy Academy.
The teacher hopes that you can seize these few days and make adequate preparations, strive to get good results in the assessment in one week, and be admitted to your ideal college. "
In a classroom, a class teacher wearing glasses said with a serious face.
Of course, only he knew that these were just words of encouragement.
There are too few people who can actually pass the assessment.
It would be nice to have a few in his own class.
As for the students sitting below, some looked sad, some looked very happy, and so on.
"Okay, that's all I've said. Now...school is over."
Afterwards, the head teacher directly announced that school was over, turned around and left the classroom.
Just after the head teacher left the room, various sounds came and went in the classroom.
“Fuck!
How come time flies by so fast!
Three years passed in a flash. "
"Who says it's not the case? With our current strength, there is no need to think about the four top Spirit Controlling Academy. The advanced Spirit Controlling Academy basically doesn't need to be considered. Let's think about how to get into a Spirit Controlling Academy. I don't ask for much, any one will do."
"If you can't even get into an ordinary Spirit Controlling Academy, then you're really doomed and you'll have to be an ordinary person for the rest of your life."
“Hahahaha!
My goal is the Advanced Spirit Controlling Academy. Although I cannot reach the top four Spirit Controlling Academy, with my strength, there is no problem in attending the Advanced Spirit Controlling Academy. "
"I'm envious!"
…
Hearing this news, some people were happy and some were sad.
Those who are happy are naturally those who feel that their strength is sufficient, while those who are worried are those who think that their strength is insufficient and may be eliminated at any time.
Among this group of people, there was one person who had been sitting in his seat.
Completely different from the noise around him, this man was silent and incompatible with everything around him.
Ye Ling looked at the noisy classmates around him, and his mood was very complicated.
But as a time traveler, I have seen a lot of things, and my whole person has matured a lot.
I won't yell or make a fuss just because of this little thing.
But when he thought about the open enrollment assessment that would be held in a week, Ye Ling couldn't help but sigh.
"Alas!"
Ye Ling is not a person of this world, but a time traveler.
He came into this world a week ago under unexpected circumstances.
The soul directly occupied the magpie's nest and swallowed up the dying soul in the body.
